description: Source code for inspecting and dumping contents of disk cache files, including headers, entries, rankings, and stats, with functions for reading headers, dumping stats, and managing cache entries.

classes.name: CacheDumper
classes.description: Class for interacting with cache files, loading entries and rankings, and dumping cache data.

methods.name: ReadHeader
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the beginning of a file.

methods.name: GetMajorVersionFromFile
methods.description: Extracts major version number from cache index header.

methods.name: DumpStats
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a cache stats record.

methods.name: DumpIndexHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header information of the index file.

methods.name: DumpBlockHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header information of a block file.

methods.name: CacheDumper::Init
methods.description: Initializes cache dumper by loading cache files and index.

methods.name: CacheDumper::GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the next cache entry and its address.

methods.name: CacheDumper::LoadEntry
methods.description: Loads a specific cache entry from disk.

methods.name: CacheDumper::LoadRankings
methods.description: Loads rankings data from disk.

methods.name: CacheDumper::HexDump
methods.description: Creates a hex dump of data at a given cache address.

methods.name: ToLocalTime
methods.description: Converts timestamp to local time string.

methods.name: DumpEntry
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a cache entry.

methods.name: DumpRankings
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a rankings node.

methods.name: PrintCSVHeader
methods.description: Prints CSV header for cache entries.

methods.name: DumpCSV
methods.description: Outputs cache entry and rankings data in CSV format.

methods.name: CanDump
methods.description: Checks if a cache address can be dumped.

methods.name: GetMajorVersion
methods.description: Gets the major version of cache files in a directory.

methods.name: DumpHeaders
methods.description: Dumps headers of all cache files in a directory.

methods.name: DumpContents
methods.description: Dumps all cache entries and related info.

methods.name: DumpLists
methods.description: Dumps linked list of cache entries.

methods.name: DumpEntryAt
methods.description: Dumps specific cache entry at given address.

methods.name: DumpAllocation
methods.description: Dumps allocation map of a cache block file.
